sources.sanitization: Local prototype uses sanitized example fixtures.
observations: Margin column and 760px main column; navigation centred on the page's centre line.
Comment feed grouped by full date without weekday, with deletion confirmed on a sheet under the comment.
Boxed setting inputs, one input per item for lists, save on change and guarded navigation.
Centred two-line footer under every signed-in view: "Powered by Ecoku" and the running release tag, both linked.

Search box to the right of the status tabs (its own full-width row on narrow screens); words must all match, #123 finds a comment number, and deleted comments match on page title, page key and number only.
While a search is on its way the current page stays, dimmed; matches are marked with a light amber ground, never in the quoted parent.
limitations: Prototype fixtures do not establish API behavior.
